title: Northern Sweden police investigator of the ghost rocket era
summary: Clas Svahn tells of Northern Sweden police investigator of the ghost rocket era, about 1940s at northern Sweden, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: A researcher named Clas Svahn, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, talks about the ghost rockets, a wave of unexplained objects people reported over Sweden in the 1940s. Svahn says one of the people looking into them was a policeman far up in the north of the country. He mentions it as part of the record of how those sightings were investigated at the time.
